verdict.rationale: Stagehand can run against a local browser or attach over CDP. In local mode the user-data directory, holding cookies and local storage, stays on disk under the user's control, which gives some implicit portability and lets you avoid the hosted service. However, nothing documents exporting data held server-side, such as Browserbase contexts, session data or the server-side act/observe/extract cache. Missing for 10: a documented export of Browserbase contexts, session recordings and cached results; a statement on open export formats or account offboarding; independent confirmation that users can leave with their data.
